Stay Warm This Fall With the Latest Walt Disney World Hoodies

If you are a frequent reader here at MickeyBlog, you know we are always on the lookout for the latest Disney apparel. [1]

Whether we are browsing the Disney Store, shopping at Disneyland Resort, or searching high and low throughout Walt Disney World, we are dedicated to bringing you the latest Disney clothing as it is released. [1]

Earlier today, we brought you an update on the new Walt Disney World fall spirit jersey and the new Daisy Duck denim jacket that arrived at the Disney Store. [1]

Chip n’ Dale Hoodie

When we visited World of Disney this morning, we were thrilled to see a new Chip ‘n’ Dale sweatshirt had arrived. [1]
